body:
Chairman and CEO at Microsoft

Bringing Salesforce to Copilot as we build Copilot as the OS for work!

Introducing Copilotforce Salesforce customer context and sales workflows are coming to Microsoft Copilot and Teams—where more than 400M people already collaborate Our expanded partnership with Microsoft spans Copilot, Teams & Fabric: → Salesforce in Microsoft Copilot will help sellers prepare for meetings, spot deal risks & take supported Salesforce actions, informed by customer context, emails, meetings & shared documents → Sales Cloud in Teams will bring pipeline insights, deal alerts & supported opportunity updates into Teams, with Agentforce Coworker helping sellers delegate work & take action → Salesforce Data 360 + Microsoft Fabric connect through bidirectional zero copy, so teams can access data across both platforms without duplicating source datasets → Informatica expands its Microsoft integrations to help teams find trusted data in Copilot, build governed AI agents in Foundry & trace data lineage in Fabric Accenture joins as Customer Zero and design and implementation partner to help shape and validate Copilotforce within its global sales organization, after scaling Microsoft Copilot to 740,000+ people See what’s new from #MSIgnite : https://sforce.co/4C90lqk
